summary: Aardvark Therapeutics filed an 8-K on October 8, 2026 reporting the board's October 6 appointment of Dr. David (Zhongwei) Zhang as a Class II director effective October 7, 2026, plus Item 8.01 other events and Item 9.01 exhibits. Compensation follows the Non-Employee Director Program: $40,000 annual cash retainer, prorated, and a stock option grant dated October 7, 2026. No acquisition, tender, strategic review, or capital action is disclosed; this is a routine board-composition disclosure with no deal terms or advisors named. Watch for subsequent Form 4 filings and future 10-Q disclosure on equity awards.
